Sources & standards

A useful guide starts with
being clear about the facts.

01 / TRACE THE SOURCE

Show where it came from.

Each profile links to HAR and the professional’s own public pages. Brokerage details and selected background statements are attributed to those sources.

02 / LEAVE OUT THE GUESSWORK

Keep claims in proportion.

Unverified sales totals, review counts, awards, and “best agent” claims have been left out. A self-published biography is treated as a biography, not an independent audit.

03 / CHECK WHAT MATTERS

Confirm before you commit.

Public pages can change or lag behind reality. Check current licensing, brokerage, services, fees, and availability with the professional and relevant official sources.

Reviewed October 3, 2026. No agent interviews, review audits, address-level knowledge tests, or comparative scoring were performed. Profiles are presented for your own research, without comparative scoring or endorsement.

Before the first call

Bring questions that matter to you.

If you’re selling

Get specific about
the plan for your home.

  • Which comparable sales would you use to discuss a list price?
  • What marketing, photography, and showing services are included?
  • How will we review buyer feedback and decide whether to adjust?
If you’re buying

Understand the process
before you fall in love.

  • What experience do you have in the neighborhoods I’m considering?
  • How will we check property-specific taxes, restrictions, and other costs?
  • What should I understand about representation and compensation before touring?
A few fair questions

Clear from the start.

Is this a ranking of the best agents?

No. It is a sourced directory adapted from a design concept. Profiles appear alphabetically, and the opening Lippincott Team placement demonstrates a featured layout. It does not establish a “best” agent or an independently scored winner.

Is the featured placement sponsored?

No paid sponsorship or endorsement has been established for this example. The featured layout is a design demonstration. Any future paid relationship should be confirmed and clearly disclosed before the site is used as a live commercial guide.

What was actually checked?

Names, brokerage affiliations, business contacts, and selected professional details were checked against the sources linked on each page. Some details are self-reported by the agents. This is not an audit of sales, reviews, reputation, or local knowledge.

How current is the information?

Public sources were reviewed on October 3, 2026. The site is a fixed snapshot and does not update automatically. A linked source can itself be outdated; confirm current affiliation, licensing, services, and availability directly before relying on them.

Can I contact an agent here?

Each profile links to the professional’s public website and HAR page. Where included, phone numbers are public business contacts from those sources. This example does not collect or forward inquiries; contact terms and any fees should be confirmed directly.

Does this example collect my contact details?

There are no inquiry forms, email signups, or lead-submission features on this example. Outbound links open other sites, which have their own privacy practices. Site hosting and font services may process routine technical request information.
